threshold_changes.notes: Info tier at 65% per optimization report (was 50% initially in LCK-RD-001 design). Two duplicate old rules (ALR-019/020) merged. ALR-020 eliminated as duplicate PromQL.

Changed from absolute count (>300 in 3min) to rate-based (per minute). Three Grafana duplicates (ALR-133/134/135) and one PromQL duplicate (ALR-026) eliminated. New metric uses rate(mysql_global_status_slow_queries[5m]) * 60.
Optimization report raised from 12/24/48 to 25/50/100. Old system had only one level at >24. Two duplicate old rules (ALR-027/028) merged.
Converted from pure absolute (<10GB) to percentage-based with absolute fallback. Addresses instance size inconsistency (10GB = 37% on small vs 1.5% on large).
ALR-022 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. Added graduated response: 30s info (probe failure), 45s warning (possible failover), 1m critical (confirmed outage).
ALR-024 was _语音 duplicate eliminated. New system adds warning tier for abnormally long failover (>2 min). Info tier captures event for logging.
Critical gap identified after isalescdp OOM failover (2026-03-12). FreeableMemory dropped to 82-102MB with no alert. Percentage + absolute fallback for size-agnostic detection.
Critical gap. isalescdp SwapUsage reached 530MB before OOM. Any swap usage on RDS indicates memory pressure.
New alert for read replica lag. Affects read-write splitting consistency.
Old ALR-050 was generic (all exporters). New system has dedicated RDS exporter alert with graduated duration. Prevents monitoring blind spots.
Added info at 50%. Warning threshold unchanged at 70% but duration changed from 3m to 5m. Critical at 90% with 3m duration added.

Optimization report noted isales-market incident: 61%->87% in 20 min. Recommended 75% warning but new YAML uses 80%. Added absolute fallback for small instances. Critical at 95% with just 1m duration for fast response.
Changed from average latency to P99. Optimization report recommended lowering warning to 2ms (from 5ms in intermediate design). Redis should respond in microseconds; 5ms is already severe.
Old rule triggered on ANY eviction (>0 in 5min). New system uses rate-based thresholds to distinguish incidental vs significant vs catastrophic eviction.
Old 30% threshold was too aggressive for production. Raised info to 50%, warning to 70%, critical at 90%. Added duration requirements.
Two separate alerts (buffer + bandwidth) merged into unified network bandwidth alert. Added info tier at 20Mbps and critical at 50Mbps.
Blocked clients signal merged into Redis connection health alert (LCK-RE-008). No longer a standalone alert.
Old rule had no duration (instant trigger). New system adds graduated duration to avoid alert on brief network blips.
